name: WdLockType
description: Specifies the type of lock for a CoAuthLock object.

constants.name: wdLockReservation
constants.description: Specifies a reservation lock. A reservation lock is explicitly created by a user through the Block Authors button on the Review tab in Word.

constants.name: wdLockEphemeral
constants.description: Specifies an ephemeral lock. Word implicitly places an ephemeral lock on a range when a user begins editing a range in a document with coauthoring enabled.

constants.name: wdLockChanged
constants.description: Specifies a placeholder lock. A placeholder lock indicates that another user has removed their lock from the range, but the current user has not updated their view of the document by saving.
